title: aliStair on FlyQuest: “It’s really about trying to be the glue”
content:
FlyQuest’s AWPer and in-game leader sees his job as making room for the players around him.

FlyQuest had a role problem: INS was calling, while nettik and Vexite both wanted to play aggressively. Alistair “aliStair” Johnston took over the calls when he rejoined the organisation on 2 September. Less than three months later, the Australians are through Stage 1 of the PGL Major Singapore 2026 at 3-0, and aliStair told HLTV that his part in it is mostly holding the others together.

FlyQuest beat Eternal Fire and PARIVISION on Dust2 on 24 November, then swept Imperial a day later. Ninjas in Pyjamas were the only other team to get through Stage 1 without a loss.

The numbers back up how aliStair describes his role. Over the four maps he went 50-48, the lowest kill total in the team, while nettik (65-55) and jks (64-50) did the heavy fragging. His best game was the win over PARIVISION, where he finished 16-10 with 70.5 ADR.

The way he sees it, FlyQuest work when the system makes sense and everyone has room to play their own role:

We have aggressive players, and then we have our passive players. We have jks, and we have INS and stuff. So it’s really about trying to be the glue for these people because they have so much f***ing talent.

title: REJECT Reports $2.61 Million Net Loss for Year to July 2026, Closes PUBG Mobile Division
content:
Japanese esports organisation REJECT lost ¥416.1 million, about $2.61 million (₹24.5 crore), in the financial year that ended on 31 July 2026. The figure comes from the company’s financial notice in Japan’s Official Gazette, known as Kanpo, published on 25 November. The loss is more than double the ¥187.9 million the company reported in its previous published results.

There is a large gap in what the notice shows, however. REJECT is privately held, so its legal filing contains only a short balance sheet and the final profit or loss figure, with no revenue, costs or division breakdown. The company has not explained the loss publicly, and the notice was published a day before REJECT shut down its PUBG Mobile division.

The balance sheet in the Kanpo notice for REJECT Inc. shows a company carrying heavy short term debts against a thin equity base. TalkEsport converted the main figures into US dollars and Indian rupees below.

The most important number is the gap between assets and debts. REJECT had ¥1.009 billion in total assets against ¥821.2 million in liabilities, which leaves just ¥187.6 million in net assets. Most of those liabilities, ¥667.6 million, fall due within a year, which means the company needs steady cash coming in to meet them.

The accumulated deficit of ¥1.585 billion shows how much REJECT has lost in total since it was founded in 2018. That deficit is larger than the company’s total assets. The fact that net assets are still positive suggests REJECT has relied on investor funding to cover its losses over the years.

REJECT has not given a reason for the loss, but its spending over the past two years points to rapid expansion. The company raised ¥1.07 billion, about $6.72 million, in a Series B funding round in November 2024. Its staff count then grew from around 30 to more than 60, and it signed new players and creators across several games.

title: ohnePixel vs Hasan Explained: How GTA 6’s Mandy Started a Streamer Feud
content:
GTA 6’s most talked about side character has pulled two of the biggest streamers on the internet into a public row. CS2 streamer Mark “ohnePixel” Zimmermann said finding out that Mandy’s voice actress is a fan of Hasan “HasanAbi” Piker had spoiled the character for him, and Piker hit back on his own stream with a string of insults. Clips of both sides spread across X on 26 November, with the main pair passing more than 4 million views between them.

The drama has little to do with GTA 6 itself, and a lot to do with politics, streamer rivalries and an old controversy that keeps following Piker. This explainer sets out what each streamer said, where the argument started and why it grew so quickly.

The row began with Lexie Shoaibi, the actress who voices and performs Mandy, one of GTA 6’s breakout characters. Rockstar’s official site lists Shoaibi as Mandy, and she has said she did both the voice and the motion capture for the role. On 22 November, three days after the game launched, she appeared on Piker’s Twitch stream, where she played GTA, helped with a charity fundraiser and talked about her sudden fame.

During the segment, Piker asked Shoaibi about her politics, and she described herself as “super woke”. Piker said on stream that he first heard about her through a mutual friend, who told him the person behind Mandy was a fan of his. The appearance drew a wave of criticism online, as part of the wider argument over whether GTA 6 has gone woke .

OhnePixel, a German streamer best known for Counter-Strike skins and case openings, has been playing GTA 6 almost every day since launch. On a recent stream, he reacted to the Shoaibi appearance and admitted it had changed how he sees the character.

“I’m not a fan of the guy, especially for the shocking sh*t, but it adds some side taste,” ohnePixel said, according to clips shared on X. “Every time I hear Mandy in game now, she’s like a big Hasan fan.” He followed it with a joke that went viral on its own: “When I pull up at Mandy’s now, I think I’m hooking up with Hasan’s friend.”

title: SouL Goblin Says “We’re Far From Done” After Team SouL Qualify for PMGC 2026 Grand Finals
content:
Team SouL ‘s Harsh “Goblin” Paudwal has promised that the team is “far from done” after qualifying for the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026 Grand Finals through the Gauntlet Stage. In a message to his Instagram broadcast channel on 27 November, Goblin admitted that SouL made “a few small mistakes” in Istanbul, but said the team will go into the Grand Finals with “only one thing on our minds”, the number one spot. The post had been seen by more than 26,000 followers and drawn over 6,000 reactions when TalkEsport checked.

The statement came hours after SouL finished sixth in the Gauntlet with 91 points, taking the last direct place in the Grand Finals. The team had started Day 2 in 11th place, and the full run is covered in our report on how Team SouL qualified for the PMGC 2026 Grand Finals . Goblin’s message reads less like a celebration and more like a warning that SouL expects more from itself in December.

Goblin opened the post with the headline news, writing “INTO THE PMGC 2026 FINALS!!” before turning quickly to what comes next. He then made clear that qualification was only a first step.

He then set out the target for the Grand Finals in plain terms. “When we step onto that stage for the finals, I want us to play with no regrets, no hesitation, and only one thing on our minds THAT #1 SPOT!” he wrote. Goblin closed by thanking fans for “all the unreal love and support” and added, “Me and my team are not done yet”, signing off with an evil eye emoji.

Goblin did not say which moments he meant, but the Gauntlet gave him plenty to choose from. On Day 2, SouL tried to third party a fight between 4K Esports and Gaming Stars on Erangel and lost the whole squad within seconds, finishing 14th. In the next game, the team lost three players while entering the zone and ended the match in seventh.

The most painful moment came in the fourth match of the day. SouL reached the endgame on Erangel with all four players alive and the zone in its favour, which looked like a strong chance for a Chicken Dinner. Sharper Esports eliminated Nakul, and SouL chose to fight XForce Rejects on the other side, a decision that left the team third with eight finishes while Sharper won the match.

title: LPL : Viper fonce vers DRX, BLG explore plusieurs pistes
content:
Le feuilleton touche à sa fin. Quelques semaines après avoir décroché son deuxième titre de champion du monde, Park « Viper » Do-hyeon s’apprêterait à quitter Bilibili Gaming. Selon les informations du média sud-coréen OSEN , l’AD Carry de 26 ans aurait trouvé un accord avec Kiwoom DRX pour un contrat d’un an, assorti du plus gros salaire de l’effectif.

Malgré une offre avoisinant les 2,25 millions de dollars annuels de la part de BLG, Viper aurait privilégié un retour en Corée du Sud pour se rapprocher de sa mère, atteinte d’un cancer. Le joueur a d’ailleurs laissé peu de place au doute lors d’un récent live, remerciant ses supporters chinois et expliquant que le public de la LPL allait lui manquer.

Seulement neuvième de la LCK en 2026, Kiwoom DRX pourrait frapper un grand coup sur le marché des transferts. Viper devrait notamment retrouver Scout, avec qui il avait remporté les Worlds en 2021 sous les couleurs d’EDward Gaming. Lucid (Dplus KIA), Duro (Gen.G) et le jeune Haetae seraient également attendus pour compléter un roster particulièrement séduisant sur le papier.

De son côté, Bilibili Gaming s’intéresserait à JackeyLove, libre depuis la fin de son contrat avec Top Esports, selon l’insider chinois Summoner Park. Les discussions avec le champion du monde 2018 ne seraient toutefois pas encore très avancées. La direction de BLG envisagerait également un retour d’Elk, dont elle aurait déjà rencontré l’agent lors d’un dîner. Enfin, le jeune AD Carry sud-coréen Diable aurait été proposé par son agence, mais ne constituerait pas une priorité pour la formation chinoise. Affaire à suivre…

title: rain Passes NiKo for the Most Opening Kills in Counter-Strike Major History
content:
Håvard “rain” Nygaard now has more opening kills than any other player in Counter-Strike Major history , passing Nikola “NiKo” Kovač during the PGL Major Singapore 2026 . Figures posted on X on 27 November put rain on 557 opening kills at Majors against 556 for NiKo. The record came during 100 Thieves ‘ final Stage 1 series against M80, which the team won to reach Stage 2.

There is a caveat on the numbers, because they come from a prediction market account and not from Valve or the tournament organiser. TalkEsport could not find the same totals published by an official statistics provider. The order does match an earlier list from the same account on 3 November, which had NiKo on 556 and rain 9 behind on 547.

An opening kill is the first kill of a round, the one that gives a team a five against four advantage. It is the core job of an entry fragger, the player who goes first into a site, and rain has filled that role for most of his career. Opening kills at Majors count across every stage, so the total rewards long careers as much as raw skill.

Rain needed 10 more opening kills in Singapore to go past NiKo, and he did it within Stage 1. His biggest performance so far came on 26 November, when he scored 26 kills on Dust2 to help 100 Thieves come back from a map down and eliminate 9z 2-1. 100 Thieves then beat M80 on 27 November to finish Stage 1 at 3-2, as set out in our Stage 1 Day 4 recap .

The gap is only one, so the record could change hands again if NiKo adds opening kills at this Major. Karrigan sits third on 536, 21 behind rain. Rain is 32 and has now played 19 Majors, which explains how he has built such a big total.

Rain has played at the top level for more than a decade, mostly with FaZe Clan, where he spent years alongside NiKo in the same lineup. He won his first Major at the PGL Major Antwerp 2022 with FaZe and was named the event’s MVP. FaZe benched him in September 2025, and he signed with 100 Thieves in November 2025.

title: PGL Singapore Major 2026 Stage 1 Day 4 Recap
content:
The final day of Stage 1 of the PGL Singapore Major 2026 has come to a shocking end, with several underdogs making it through to the next stage over fan favorites . Following a tricky Day 3 , Day 4 draws the curtain on the opening stage while giving us the 8 teams that will be extending their stay in Singapore for the highly anticipated Stage 2.

A 3-0 start for the Chinese side on their opponent’s map pick put HEROIC on the back foot as they spent the majority of their offense playing chase. Having managed only 2 rounds in the first half, HEROIC pulled up their socks on defense. After securing 9 rounds while dropping only one, the Danish side leveled the scoreline only to lose the final few rounds as the stunning comeback attempt was left in vain.

With a narrow victory on Nuke, Lynn Vision started their map pick on a similar note. A dominant display of fast-paced offense on Dust2 left HEROIC with little room for a comeback. Winning the pistol round put the Chinese side on series point, but their victory was delayed by an uninspiring 4-round comeback attempt. Winning the 7th round of the second half, Lynn Vision opened Day 4 with a shocking upset and booked their spot in Stage 2.

Two heavyweights from the Far West clashed in the second tie of the day, starting on Wildcard’s pick of Dust2. With the first half of the opening map ending with a level scoreline, both sides were primed to take away the map in the second half. Wildcard secured an early lead with a 4-0 start to the second half, only to drop the ball, allowing the Brazilians to string together 7 rounds and close out the opening map with a 13-11 scoreline.

Suffering a demoralizing defeat on their own map, Wildcard bounced back with a near-flawless start on Imperial’s map, Mirage. Winning 11 rounds on the defense, the first half made a deciding map an inevitable outcome. After surviving the beating, Imperial hit back in the second half with a near-perfect streak that almost pushed the game to overtime before Wildcard converted the final round of regulation to stop the comeback in its tracks and take the series to the third map of the series.

A 3-0 start on offense from Wildcard left Imperial on the back foot. Winning the first gun round allowed the Brazilians to hit the scoreboard, after which they shifted the momentum to their side, closing the first half with a narrow lead of 7-5. While the North Americans managed to level the scoreline in the second half, Imperial pulled ahead from the first gun round of their offense with a 5-round streak to eliminate Wildcard and book their spot in Stage 2 .

title: Team Spirit Turns Seven Nation Army Into a Fan Anthem for the PGL Singapore Major
content:
Team Spirit has released a fan anthem for the PGL Major Singapore 2026 , reworking The White Stripes’ Seven Nation Army as “Spirit Nation Army”. The two and a half minute video went up on the Team Spirit CS YouTube channel on 27 November, with new English lyrics about the team, its fans and its dragon logo. Spirit wrote in the video description that the anthem is meant for fans in the stands, “not only at this Major but at every tournament we compete in”.

The choice of song is a natural fit for a crowd chant. The guitar riff from Seven Nation Army has been sung in football stadiums for two decades, and Spirit has swapped the famous wordless chant for its own call of “PA-PA-PA-PA Team Spirit!”. The release lands as the Major moves towards its later stages in Singapore.

The lyrics follow the original song’s structure, with verses about fighting every opponent and a chorus built for a crowd to shout back. Spirit’s fan base is called the “Spirit nation” in the song, and the dragon from the team’s logo appears throughout, with the chorus announcing that the Dragon is coming to Singapore.

The song also looks back at Spirit’s past success. One line asks fans to “rinse and repeat Shanghai”, a nod to the team’s Major title at the Perfect World Shanghai Major in 2024. Another says the trophies already in the team’s hall “will never be enough”, which sets out the target for Singapore plainly.

Team Spirit said the anthem was written “together with the guys”, meaning the players and staff behind the team. The video description says the organisation wants it to be heard in the stands at every event Spirit plays from now on, not only at this Major.

Spirit goes into the Major after a mixed few weeks. The team reached the BLAST Rivals Season 2 final this month but lost 3-0 to FURIA, the side now known in the community as the CS2 mayonnaise team because of its Hellmann’s sponsor. Spirit also appears on PGL’s list of declared conflicts of interest for the Singapore Major , because SYPH0 is playing for Nemiga Gaming on loan from Spirit.

title: FalleN Wants a Dota 2 Style Compendium for CS2 Majors, With Team Voice Lines and Exclusive Skins
content:
FURIA’s Gabriel “FalleN” Toledo has called on Valve to bring a Dota 2 style Compendium to Counter-Strike 2 Majors, with team voice lines, tournament gloves and skins that can only be earned while a Major is running. The Brazilian posted his plan on X on 27 November, during the PGL Major Singapore, and tagged Counter-Strike’s official account. The post passed 189,000 views and 10,000 likes within hours, and fans quickly replied that Valve should put him in charge of CS2 esports.

The timing is not an accident. Valve’s Major sticker system has left many teams earning far less than before, a problem set out in our editorial on the CS2 sticker money crisis . FalleN’s ideas focus on giving fans new reasons to spend during a Major, and on making that spending feel like a shared goal for the whole community.

There is so many things that @CounterStrike could add into the major landscape to increase hype, desire and money collective incentive for the competition. Voice lines, special skins, team gloves, release of new maps… Compedium vibes from DOTA2 could fix it all If it was in…

FalleN said there are “so many things” Valve could add to the Major landscape “to increase hype, desire and money collective incentive for the competition”. He pointed to the Compendium that Valve once sold for Dota 2’s The International, writing that “Compedium vibes from DOTA2 could fix it all”. In Dota 2, Compendium sales unlocked rewards as the community hit set goals, and a share of the money went into the tournament’s prize pool.

His post set out a list of features built around community goals.

“If it was in my hands i would make in a way where community feel the desire to help the competition/ecosystem, not only because they are hoping to get a valuable item, but because they can see what will be unlocked next if goals are reached,” FalleN wrote. He ended the post by asking fans what else would be worth having.

title: GTA 6 Raul’s Plan Softlock: How to Fix Raul Not Calling Lucia
content:
A softlock in GTA 6’s Chapter 4 is stopping some players from finishing the main story because Raul never calls Lucia during the mission Raul’s Plan. The bug shows up at about 72% story completion, and waiting, sleeping, or playing side activities does not trigger the call for affected saves. Rockstar has not acknowledged this specific bug, and players have shared a workaround that has helped some of them, although it is not guaranteed to work.

Rockstar already fixed a similar problem with important phone calls failing to trigger in the GTA 6 update 01.002.002 patch notes on 23 November. Players are still reporting the Raul’s Plan softlock following that update. The fix below covers the steps that have worked for players so far, starting with the tasks the game may be waiting on before Raul calls.

Raul’s Plan is a waiting mission, and the game will not send Raul’s call until every earlier task in Chapter 4 is done. In many cases, the call is held back by an unfinished job, not by a bug. Before trying the full fix, check that you have finished these tasks.

Raul’s call always goes to Lucia, not Jason. If you have done everything above and the call still does not arrive after an in-game day or two, your save has most likely hit the softlock.

This workaround comes from players who were stuck on the mission. Follow the steps in order.

If the fix works, you may get a call from Valentina before Raul. Finish her mission, and pay the lawyer’s fee if you have not already done so. Raul should call Lucia after that, and the story will move on.

title: Fortnite Kicks: A complete list of all shoes in the game

title: LCS : Sentinels mise sur Horder pour remplacer Impact
content:
Après avoir misé sur l’expérience d’Impact pour son arrivée en LCS en 2026, Sentinels devrait prendre une tout autre direction pour la saison à venir. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , la structure nord-américaine aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec Chris « Horder » Feng. Le Canadien succéderait ainsi à l’ancien champion du monde sud-coréen, actuellement en négociations avancées avec LYON.

Passé par quatre équipes en l’espace de quelques mois en 2026, Horder a véritablement explosé sous les couleurs de Cupid Esports, avec qui il a remporté le Summer Split de la NACL. Un sacre qui lui a également permis de découvrir la scène internationale lors du World Star Challengers Invitational, où son équipe a été éliminée par T1 Academy. Malgré l’échec de Cupid Esports lors du tournoi de promotion en LCS, le toplaner devrait donc avoir l’opportunité de découvrir l’élite nord-américaine en 2027.

Contrairement à la plupart de ses concurrents, Sentinels a décidé de conserver la quasi-intégralité de son effectif. Arrivée en LCS en 2026 en reprenant la place de 100 Thieves, l’organisation avait réalisé des débuts encourageants avant de rentrer dans le rang au fil de la saison, sans parvenir à se qualifier pour la moindre compétition internationale.

Horder devrait ainsi évoluer aux côtés de HamBak, DARKWINGS, Rahel et huhi, tous de retour pour une deuxième saison chez Sentinels. La structure nord-américaine serait donc celle ayant effectué le moins de changements durant cette intersaison en LCS. Une stabilité qui pourrait constituer un précieux avantage en début d’année, même si le jeune Canadien aura la lourde tâche de succéder à l’un des toplaners les plus emblématiques de l’histoire du championnat.

title: Tarzan Faces €2.42M Korean Tax Bill After Residency Ruling
content:
Anyone's Legend jungler Tarzan, whose full name is Lee Seung-yong, has lost a residency dispute with South Korea's National Tax Service. Officials never named the petitioner, but the career details match his. The agency says he owes about 3.54 billion KRW (€2.42 million) in tax on what he earned in the LPL from 2021 to 2024.

Anyone's Legend jungler Tarzan, whose full name is Lee Seung-yong, has lost a residency dispute with South Korea's National Tax Service. Officials never named the petitioner, but the career details match his. The agency says he owes about 3.54 billion KRW (€2.42 million) in tax on what he earned in the LPL from 2021 to 2024.

The agency turned down a review petition and left a comprehensive income tax assessment of roughly 3.54 billion KRW in place. It applies to the 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 tax years. Under the ruling he counts as a Korean resident, so his income from abroad is taxable in South Korea.

The agency did not release a name. Its description fits one career: a player who debuted with a Korean organization in 2017, stayed in the Korean league through 2020, joined a Chinese club in 2021 for the LPL and switched to a different Chinese side in 2024. That path matches Tarzan, who is 27 and has a deal with Anyone's Legend until November 2027. He also played at Worlds 2026 , where his team left without winning a game.

An audit earlier this year put about 6.3 billion KRW (€4.31 million) down as his own income from playing. That figure covers his pay from LNG Esports and Weibo Gaming. It also covers fees that went to an agency in South Korea run by his family.

Tarzan asked to be treated as someone who does not live in South Korea. He said he was in China for 313 days a year on average between 2021 and 2024, and that he paid income tax there. He added that China granted him permanent residency in April 2026.

title: CDL : Paris Gentle Mates désigné grand favori du Kickoff Classic
content:
Le nouveau roster de Gentle Mates impose déjà le respect outre-Atlantique. Pour déterminer les têtes de série du Kickoff Classic 2027, la Call of Duty League a demandé à ses douze équipes de classer leurs adversaires. Et c’est la formation parisienne qui a remporté les suffrages, avec six votes en première position sur onze possibles. Toronto KOI et OpTic Texas complètent le podium, tandis que FaZe Vegas occupe la quatrième place.

The teams have spoken All 12 CDL teams ranked each other to determine seeding for the Kickoff Classic, starting December 4th! pic.twitter.com/l1wOFpOct9

Une belle marque de reconnaissance pour Paris Gentle Mates, qui a frappé fort sur le marché des transferts en s’offrant trois des champions du monde en titre, Drazah, Abuzah et 04, pour accompagner JoeDeceives. Le quatuor a déjà montré de belles choses lors du Monster Energy Launch Invitational sur Modern Warfare 4, en terminant deuxième derrière Toronto KOI. Les Canadiens avaient pourtant dominé les M8 à deux reprises, en finale du winner bracket (3-1), puis en grande finale (4-1).

Ce statut de tête de série numéro un permet à Paris Gentle Mates d’hériter d’un groupe à sa portée pour le Kickoff Classic, qui débutera le 4 décembre prochain. Les protégés de Gotaga retrouveront Miami Heretics et G2 Minnesota, respectivement huitième et neuvième du classement établi par les équipes de la CDL, ainsi que les Huntsmen, une formation issue du circuit Challengers. C’est face à cette dernière que M8 lancera son tournoi.

Au total, seize équipes participeront à cette première compétition, dont quatre formations du circuit Challengers. Réparties en quatre groupes, elles s’affronteront dans un format GSL en BO5, avec deux places qualificatives par poule pour les playoffs. Ces derniers se disputeront dans un arbre à double élimination, avec une grande finale en BO7. Pour Gentle Mates, l’occasion sera belle de confirmer son statut de favori et de décrocher un premier trophée avec son nouvel effectif.

TOUT SIMPLEMENT CALL OF DUTY ! On vous présente notre roster CDL pour la saison 2027 avec @lofigirl pic.twitter.com/xAIhv7dDVH

title: Third time on Cache takes Imperial into Stage 2
content:
Imperial had lost Cache twice this week, once in overtime. With a Stage 2 place on it, they won 13-8.

Imperial had played Cache twice at this Major and lost both times, 9-13 to FlyQuest and 13-16 in overtime to Liquid . With a Stage 2 place riding on it against Wildcard , they won it 13-8. That completed a 2-1 in which Imperial came back from 6-11 to win Dust2 and from 1-11 to take Mirage to the last round of regulation, and it sends them into Stage 2 of the PGL Major Singapore 2026 at 3-2. Wildcard’s first Major ends at 2-3.

Imperial had the news out a few minutes after the last round.

CLASSIFICADOS PRO STAGE 2 🔥 2×1 contra Wildcard no Major Singapura Amanhã com horário e adversário a se definir! VAMOOOO #goimp pic.twitter.com/EkhycFSxje

Cache stayed close for longer than either of the first two maps. Wildcard won the pistol round and went 3-0 up, Imperial levelled at 4-4 and took the first half 7-5 on the CT side. saadzin set the tone on A, where he shut down one of Wildcard’s fast hits with three kills on his own.

Wildcard won the second pistol round as well, and the score went back and forth to 8-8. In that stretch VINI sold a fake on A so well that Wildcard’s whole defence ended up in the wrong part of the map. Then Imperial took the last five rounds. saadzin won one of them with four kills after nEMANHA had gone looking for a fight alone, and chelo took down Wildcard’s AWPer for 12-8. Wildcard’s final timeout changed nothing.

title: Fnatic hand Boaster’s calls to American IGL valyn
content:
Four VCT Americas titles with G2 Esports, and now a move across the Atlantic.

Fnatic have signed Jacob “valyn” Batio from G2 Esports as their new in-game leader, putting the American controller player next to kaajak, Cloud and marteen for the 2027 VCT season. The 23-year-old takes over the calls from Boaster, who joined Gentle Mates this week.

Fnatic revealed the move on 26 November with a video titled “We Need An AMERICAN!” on their FNATIC Valorant YouTube channel and a post on X. “An NA icon has joined the Black and Orange,” the club wrote. As with marteen a day earlier, Fnatic marked the signing “pending Riot approval”.

An NA icon has joined the Black and Orange. Welcome to FNATIC, @valynfps 🧡 https://t.co/MjMYSdVq7R pic.twitter.com/fkfYFCDn2J

valyn leaves North America after eight straight international events. He grew up in California, started with Flow State in 2020, played for Complexity in 2021 and broke through with The Guard, who won Challengers NA Stage 1 in 2022 and went to Masters Reykjavík. In 2023 that roster won Americas Ascension, and when The Guard’s owners did not sign Riot’s participation agreement, the core moved to G2 Esports, who Riot added as the 11th team in VCT Americas.

With valyn calling, G2 won four Americas titles and went to eight international events in a row, from Masters Shanghai 2024 to Champions 2026. The closest he came to an international trophy was Masters Bangkok 2025, where G2 lost the grand final 2-3 to T1. His last event for G2 was Champions 2026, where G2 finished fourth, and G2 and valyn split on 28 October.

title: Bucharest clash pushes BLAST Bounty invites down to 26th place
content:
Eleven of the 12 teams we projected in early November got the call, with HOTU taking the place of The MongolZ.

Twelve invites, and only one of them went to a team from the top 12 of Valve’s global standings. BLAST revealed the invited teams for BLAST Bounty 2027 Season 1 , also known as BLAST Bounty Winter 2027, on 26 November: 1win, NAVI , Ninjas in Pyjamas , PARIVISION , HEROIC , FaZe Clan , Team Liquid , Eternal Fire , 100 Thieves , 9z , M80 and HOTU.

The event runs from 14 to 24 January at BLAST Arena Studios in Malta. Four more places go to qualifier winners from Europe, North America, South America and Asia.

It's time to reveal the invited teams that will be joining us this January in Malta for the BLAST Premier Bounty 2027! 🇲🇹 #BLASTPremier pic.twitter.com/jCt618Vuf2

The top of the rankings will be in Romania instead. PGL Bucharest 2027 runs from 17 to 24 January, which covers the Bounty from its fourth day to the final, and PGL sent its invites first. It took the top 14 from Valve’s 5 October standings, and all 14 accepted .

BLAST’s invites follow the 2 November standings instead, and by then 11 of the global top 12 were already booked for Bucharest. That pushed the invites down to 26th place. Two teams on the Bounty list show how fast the standings moved in a month: NAVI were 34th with 1,427 points in October and 13th with 1,589 in November, while 1win climbed from 38th to 12th.

title: BBL Esports adds oroni, ComeBack in offseason rebuild
Gentle Mates : quand Boaster annonçait son transfert sous les yeux de tout le monde !
content:
Voilà qui devrait amuser les fans de VALORANT. Alors que son avenir faisait l’objet de nombreuses spéculations après six années passées chez Fnatic, Jake « Boaster » Howlett s’est offert un petit jeu de piste sur son compte X. Le Britannique avait en effet dissimulé le nom de sa future équipe dans une série de publications en apparence totalement anodines.

Entre son message d’adieu à Fnatic, une réaction aux Worlds de League of Legends, son classement de ses chansons préférées de Taylor Swift ou encore son envie de manger une glace en plein hiver, rien ne semblait relier ses différentes publications. Et pourtant, chacune d’entre elles faisait partie d’un message soigneusement dissimulé.

Il suffisait en réalité de prendre la première lettre de chacun de ses onze tweets, publiés entre le 2 novembre et le jour de son officialisation, pour découvrir le nom de sa future équipe : G E N T L E M A T E S . Même son message d’adieu à Fnatic, débutant par les mots « End of an era », participait à cette petite énigme.

Connu pour son humour et sa personnalité décalée, Boaster s’est donc amusé à dévoiler sa future destination au nez et à la barbe de tout le monde, sans jamais mentionner le nom de Gentle Mates. Une manière particulièrement originale de faire patienter les supporters avant la Keynote du club. Reste désormais à savoir si le Britannique sera aussi créatif dans ses stratégies sur le serveur qu’il ne l’a été sur les réseaux sociaux !

Boaster has left a hidden message across his last 11 tweets pic.twitter.com/BEdlHaeGXD

title: KRÜ deny blocking Less exit, blame payments stretching to 2028
content:
The Argentine club says it is the buyer, not KRÜ, who walked away from the table.

KRÜ Esports have denied refusing to sell Felipe “Less” Basso, saying in an official statement on 26 November that the only offer they received for the Brazilian spread its payments until 2028, beyond the end of his contract, and was withdrawn while the two sides were still talking. The statement came a day after THESPIKE Brasil reported that KRÜ had told MIBR there was no deal to be made.

The statement was published in Spanish on KRÜ’s website and X. In our translation, the club said:

KRÜ did not withdraw from any negotiation and at no point told another club that Less was not for sale, nor told the player that he could not leave the club. Our goal is to complete Less’s exit so that he can continue his career at the team of his choice, and we remain open to talks until an agreement is reached.

Comunicado Oficial Nuestra posición sobre la situación de Felipe "Less" Basso. 📰 https://t.co/RqMjOWbGhF pic.twitter.com/soWww17kQA

KRÜ do not name the interested club. MIBR are the team that reached a verbal agreement with Less on 13 November, as we reported at the time , and THESPIKE Brasil names them as the club behind the offer in its follow-up on the statement .

title: PGL Major Singapore 2026 live: Stage 1 day four, the last three places in Stage 2
content:
Day four of the PGL Major Singapore is the last day of Stage 1: Swiss round 5, with three Bo3s between the six teams at 2-2. Lynn Vision play HEROIC at 07:00 CET, Imperial face Wildcard at 09:30 and M80 take on 100 Thieves at 12:00. The three winners join NIP, FlyQuest, PVISION, Liquid and Eternal Fire in Stage 2, and the three losers go home. Below are our live updates from both streams, newest first. The page updates by itself.

Stream A Up next 09:30 CET: Imperial vs Wildcard, stream A 12:00 CET: M80 vs 100 Thieves, stream A Stream A Stream B Follow the full schedule, teams and standings , read how day three went , or play out the rest of the Major in our Major simulator .

08:35 CET, Lynn Vision vs HEROIC, Dust2, 6-2: HEROIC are trying to get going on their CT side. Brollan was fully flashed by z4KR from spawn and still got the kill that stopped Lynn Vision’s opening move, and HEROIC picked up a second round. But Lynn answered straight away with high flashes through middle that caught susp, and they lead 6-2. PGL called today what it is: win or go home.

08:29 CET, Lynn Vision vs HEROIC, Dust2, 5-1: HEROIC are on the board thanks to susp, who won a 1v2 clutch, his third clutch attempt of the series. It has not changed the picture much: Lynn Vision keep winning with slow, methodical rounds rather than quick hits, and Westmelon walked past Chr1zN on A in another clean double entry, with MartinezSa running to save his AWP.

08:23 CET, Lynn Vision vs HEROIC, Dust2, 4-0: Another fast start from Lynn Vision, 4-0 up with the bomb down in round five. They have kept HEROIC guessing with smokes all over the map, three mid to B smokes on the anti-eco, long cross smokes and lurk utility, so HEROIC never know where the four players behind them are. Snappi has had to use a timeout already.

08:18 CET, Lynn Vision vs HEROIC, Dust2, 2-0: Lynn Vision start on the T side and win the first two rounds. After the pistol, HEROIC tried to stall out the second round on their eco, but MartinezSa was taken out from pit and Lynn stayed patient in the 5v4 instead of chasing kills.

title: LOUD say goodbye to Champions MVP erde
content:
The Champions MVP is the third member of LOUD’s title-winning lineup to get a farewell post.

LOUD have said goodbye to Roberto “erde” Lobos, less than six weeks after the Chilean was named MVP of their Valorant Champions win in Shanghai. The Brazilian club posted a farewell video on X on Thursday at 20:00 CET . Only DaviH and tkzin from the Shanghai lineup are set to stay for 2027, according to Sheep Esports .

In the post, written in Portuguese, LOUD said (our translation):

Today is the day we say goodbye to someone who helped write one of the most important chapters of our history. Erde, your time at LOUD will be remembered for everything we built together, the battles we faced and, above all, for reaching the top of the world side by side. Even though our paths go in different directions today, nothing erases everything we lived through and won together.

Hoje é dia de dizer adeus a alguém que ajudou a escrever um dos capítulos mais importantes da nossa história. Erde, sua passagem pela LOUD será lembrada por tudo o que construímos juntos, pelas batalhas que enfrentamos e, principalmente, por termos chegado ao topo do mundo lado… pic.twitter.com/pdxKIrfz0A

erde quoted the post 23 minutes later. Writing in Spanish, he thanked the fans for their support, “especially with everything around my mum’s situation”, and signed off with “let’s go for the next trophy” (our translations).

title: « Je crois vraiment en ce projet » : Boaster affiche ses ambitions chez Gentle Mates
content:
Présenté mercredi soir aux supporters de Gentle Mates lors de la traditionnelle Keynote du club, Jake « Boaster » Howlett s’est longuement confié à Sheep Esports sur sa nouvelle aventure. Après une saison 2026 particulièrement difficile chez Fnatic, le Britannique entend retrouver les sommets avec un roster qui s’annonce comme l’un des plus redoutables de la scène européenne. Et l’ancien capitaine de Fnatic ne compte pas se cacher derrière le statut de favori de sa nouvelle équipe.

« Je m’attends personnellement à ce que nous évoluions à un très haut niveau. Si ce n’est pas le cas, ce sera à nous, en tant qu’équipe et staff, de comprendre pourquoi. Je crois vraiment en ce projet et je ne pense pas que les choses puissent si mal tourner. VALORANT peut parfois être assez aléatoire, mais je pense que c’est mon tour de connaître une belle année. J’ai ce pressentiment » , a confié Boaster, visiblement satisfait des premiers entraînements de son équipe.

Boaster vu que tu parles français tu vas comprendre ça, on t’aime ! pic.twitter.com/6UF55H18CB

Après six années riches en émotions sous les couleurs de Fnatic, le Britannique ressentait le besoin de relever un nouveau défi. « C’était difficile, mais j’avais le sentiment que c’était le bon moment pour essayer un projet différent » , a-t-il expliqué. Séduit par le potentiel du roster et les infrastructures de Gentle Mates, Boaster n’a pas hésité à rejoindre la structure française, où il retrouvera notamment ses anciens coéquipiers Alfajer et MAGNUM, ainsi que l’entraîneur adjoint Desmo.

Le vétéran semble également particulièrement emballé par le potentiel de kozzy, le jeune prodige roumain de seulement 16 ans. « Kozzy a le talent d’une superstar à mes yeux. […] Il n’est pas là simplement parce qu’il est bon au jeu. Il a cette soif et cette passion » , a-t-il souligné. Boaster estime que Gentle Mates dispose de l’expérience et de l’environnement nécessaires pour accompagner le développement du jeune joueur, tout en lui laissant suffisamment de liberté pour exprimer son talent.

Ce changement d’équipe s’accompagnera également d’un changement de rôle pour le Britannique, qui délaissera les contrôleurs pour évoluer sur les initiateurs. Une décision notamment motivée par les opportunités du mercato et la volonté d’apporter davantage de puissance de feu à son équipe. Boaster estime également que ce repositionnement lui permettra d’être plus efficace dans ses fonctions de leader in-game.

title: LCK : Zeus se confie sur son grand retour chez T1
content:
C’est l’un des grands feuilletons de ce mercato qui a pris fin mercredi. Après deux saisons passées chez Hanwha Life Esports, Choi « Zeus » Woo-je a signé un contrat de trois ans avec T1, son club formateur. Lors d’une conférence de presse organisée pour officialiser son retour, le toplaner sud-coréen est notamment revenu sur les tensions qui avaient entouré son départ fin 2024, révélant avoir reçu de nombreuses excuses de la part du PDG de T1, Joe Marsh.

« Joe Marsh a reconnu ce qui s’était passé et s’est beaucoup excusé auprès de moi. Honnêtement, après quelque temps, je n’éprouvais plus vraiment de ressentiment. J’admire T1 depuis que je suis enfant. D’une certaine manière, c’est en regardant Faker que j’ai voulu devenir joueur professionnel. Ce n’était donc pas vraiment un obstacle pour moi » , a expliqué Zeus. Le joueur a également précisé qu’il souhaitait s’engager sur le long terme afin de s’épargner la pression mentale liée aux périodes de mercato.

Fort de son expérience chez Hanwha Life, où il a notamment remporté le MSI 2026, Zeus estime avoir considérablement élargi sa vision du jeu. « Deux ans, c’est court d’une certaine manière, mais cela a été long pour moi. J’ai l’impression d’être parti comme un gamin immature et de revenir en tant qu’adulte » , a-t-il confié. S’il ne nourrit pas de grandes inquiétudes concernant ses automatismes avec ses nouveaux coéquipiers, le Sud-Coréen entend aborder cette aventure comme s’il rejoignait une toute nouvelle équipe.

Cette conférence de presse a également été l’occasion pour Kim « Roach » Kang-hee, de retour après son service militaire, de s’exprimer sur sa nomination au poste de head coach. Conscient de l’immense pression qui accompagne cette fonction chez T1, l’ancien assistant de kkOma ne compte pas pour autant considérer ce poste comme un cadeau empoisonné. Avec un effectif composé de Zeus, Oner, Faker, Peyz et Keria, le nouveau coach aura la lourde tâche de ramener T1 au sommet après une saison 2026 sans le moindre trophée.

content:
Players have already dug up 23 hidden details in GTA 6, from a trip through hell to a Pennywise ambush in an elevator. This list ranks the best Easter eggs and secrets found in Leonida on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, biggest finds first. It contains spoilers.

Players have already dug up 23 hidden details in GTA 6, from a trip through hell to a Pennywise ambush in an elevator. This list ranks the best Easter eggs and secrets found in Leonida on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, biggest finds first. It contains spoilers.

Rockstar worlds are known for secrets that stay buried for years. Red Dead Redemption 2 came out in 2018, and fans were still chasing a huge spider web theory across its map at the end of 2025 and into 2026. GTA 6 looks set to follow the same path, and our GTA 6 hub tracks everything around the launch.

One player reached the gates of hell and fought a horde of demons before facing the devil. Win and Jason ends up on the throne.

A scientist claims the government is harvesting waste to make human clones. The pair enter a plant and step into a machine, and Jason wakes up at home. Later, a drain contains two corpses: Jason and the scientist. Another player found earlier versions of the Jason and Lucia models in a bunker that needs a code to open. Fans think both leads could be clones.

The Haymarket Building in West Ocean Beach hides the scare, but only between 10pm and 2am in game. Look for an Out of Order sign on the left elevator, a red balloon and the clown's music. Inside, balloons float around you. As the lift rises, they pop, the lights die and a Florida version of Pennywise attacks with a machete. The reward is a Carnival Ticket that works as a coupon for free underpants.

title: RLCS : même sans zen, Vitality affiche de grandes ambitions
content:
Une nouvelle ère s’ouvre chez Team Vitality. Après avoir perdu sa tête d’affiche Alexis « zen » Bernier au profit de Gentle Mates, la structure française a décidé de reconstruire son effectif Rocket League autour de nass, Oski et du jeune prodige brésilien diaz, âgé de seulement 18 ans. Si les regards sont principalement tournés vers l’impressionnant trio de M8, les Abeilles n’entendent pas jouer les seconds rôles cette saison.

Dans un entretien accordé à Insider Gaming , nass a toutefois reconnu que sa nouvelle équipe accusait un léger retard dans sa préparation. « Nous venons de commencer les scrims, donc je pense que nous sommes un peu en retard par rapport aux autres équipes, mais nous allons travailler dur en vue de Londres et enchaîner les heures » , a expliqué le joueur. Malgré ce manque de préparation, l’entente entre les trois joueurs semble déjà prometteuse.

À quelques semaines du premier grand rendez-vous international de la saison, prévu du 9 au 13 décembre à Londres, nass se montre particulièrement optimiste. « Je pense que nous serons de vrais prétendants pour Londres » , a-t-il assuré. Même son de cloche du côté de diaz, qui affiche des ambitions sans équivoque : « Pour moi, il faut tout gagner et représenter Vitality du mieux possible. Je pense que nous sommes une bonne équipe, nous avons de la chimie et nous allons bien faire. »

La confrontation avec Gentle Mates, désormais emmené par zen, Vatira et Atow, sera évidemment particulièrement attendue. Si M8 fait figure d’épouvantail sur le papier, Vitality dispose également de sérieux arguments pour rivaliser avec les meilleures formations de la planète. Le rendez-vous londonien permettra de mesurer le potentiel de ce nouveau trio, qui aura ensuite plusieurs mois pour monter en puissance et trouver ses automatismes.

title: Ubisoft Explains Why Rainbow Six Siege Esports Is Difficult for New Viewers
content:
Rainbow Six Siege is one of the most tactically demanding games in competitive esports. For newcomers, following a professional match can be overwhelming because of complex maps, destructible environments and constantly changing strategies.

During the Rainbow Six Siege Osaka Major in November 2026, Dot Esports interviewed Nelson Garcia, Ubisoft’s director of Rainbow Six esports live events and broadcast.

In the interview, published on November 26, Garcia explained how new spectators can better understand professional matches and why the live-event experience offers more than competitive gameplay.

Unlike Counter-Strike 2 or VALORANT, Rainbow Six Siege features extensive vertical gameplay and destructible environments.

Teams can attack objectives through floors, ceilings and walls, making player positioning difficult to follow.

Every round introduces different operator combinations, defensive setups and tactical approaches.

title: Anthropic Briefly Lost Its $1 Trillion Value, Then Closed Back Above It
content:
A widely shared post on X on 25 November declared that Anthropic “is no longer worth $1 trillion”, less than a week after the company behind Claude made its stock market debut. The claim was true for part of Wednesday’s trading session, when the shares fell as low as $73.85. They then recovered to close at $82.79, which values the company at about $1.11 trillion using the share count in its final prospectus.

US stock markets are closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving, so that Wednesday close is the latest price. The swing still matters, because Anthropic has now closed below its $83 offering price twice in a row. For gaming, it is also the first real market test of a company whose models are already being used to build games, run AI squadmates and port old titles.

Anthropic priced its shares at $83 in a final prospectus dated 18 November, and they began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT the next day. The offering raised $81.34 billion before costs, and a separate $26 billion private placement brought in Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC as investors at the same price. The stock opened at $111.50, touched $115.10 and closed its first day at $97.17.

The slide began within days of the debut, during a wider sell-off in technology stocks. The shares closed at $81.90 on 24 November, down 6.5 per cent and below the offering price for the first time. On 25 November they dropped to $73.85 at their low, about 11 per cent under $83 and 36 per cent below the debut high. A late recovery then left them at $82.79, according to Google Finance data.

Analysts quoted by City AM blamed poor timing amid a wider sell-off in technology stocks, and said the underwriters could not hold the price after exercising their option to buy extra shares on 20 November. Investors are also weighing a lock-up release that reportedly lets up to 303 million shares be sold from 15 December. Yahoo Finance reported that chief executive Dario Amodei and president Daniela Amodei each sold about $280 million of shares in the IPO, at the offering price. Anthropic has not commented on the share price.

Different outlets have put very different values on the same share price, so TalkEsport worked the numbers out from Anthropic’s own filing. The prospectus lists 7.73 billion Class A shares, including the underwriters’ extra shares, and 5.64 billion Class N shares after the offering. That makes about 13.37 billion shares in total, which puts the $1 trillion line at roughly $74.81 a share.

title: GTA 6 PC Port Running on 25 FPS Hits Russian Torrent Sites
content:
An unofficial PC version of GTA 6 has started circulating on Russian torrent sites, a week after the game launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Several Russian outlets reported on 26 November that a build said to come from a port project called CGBJ had been posted for download. Posts on X claim it runs at 25 to 30 frames per second, but nothing about the release is official, and the claims have not been independently tested.

One X post describing the build said the port had “officially” reached the torrent sites, which gives the wrong impression. Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA VI, and the official GTA VI site still lists the game for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S only. Every PC build in circulation depends on files taken from the Xbox version of the game.

Russian sports outlet Championat reported that a user posted the first build of the port to torrent trackers on 26 November. That was three days after hacking group Cyberleek leaked the executable needed to launch the game, according to the same report. Mail.ru’s Hi-Tech section reported the same release and said the CGBJ project’s GitHub repository disappeared less than an hour after it went public. TalkEsport has not downloaded the files and will not link to them.

The port builds on a leaked Xbox Series build that has been spreading since Cyberleek claimed the leak on 20 November. Within days, modders were saying the game was already booting on PC , and dozens of separate projects started racing to make it playable. A fan-run tracker now lists 39 such projects, according to a technical write-up on the Russian tech community site Habr.

The requirements quoted for the CGBJ build are steep. Mail.ru listed a Ryzen 5 3600 or Core i5-10400 processor, 32GB of RAM, a graphics card with 16GB of video memory and 209GB of SSD space. The size alone shows the download is the full game rather than a small patch, which matters for the legal questions around it.

The 25 to 30 frames per second figure comes from the projects themselves and the fan tracker that follows them. That tracker reports an average of about 25 frames per second in normal play and close to 30 indoors and in cutscenes. German outlet PC Games Hardware reported lower developer measurements, with a median of 17 to 18 frames per second.

title: PGL Major Singapore 2026: Can Team Liquid and 100 Thieves Challenge the CS2 Favorites After FaZe’s Exit?

The Counter-Strike 2 calendar has reached its biggest event of the second half of 2026, with the PGL Major Singapore bringing 32 teams together from 24 November to 13 December. The tournament has a prize pool of $1.25 million, and after three days of Stage 1 it has already produced its first big casualty.

Teams such as Team Vitality, MOUZ and Team Spirit are considered to be the main contenders, but there are also several organizations looking to disrupt their plans. FaZe Clan, Team Liquid and 100 Thieves all began their campaigns in Stage 1, in accordance with the Swiss format, hoping to earn a place in the later rounds. Three days in, those three campaigns have gone in very different directions: Liquid are through to Stage 2, 100 Thieves are still alive at 2-2, and FaZe are on their way home.

According to experts and recent results, the clear favorite is Team Vitality. Their back-to-back Major titles in 2025 established them as the team to beat, while ZywOo and ropz provide the kind of individual quality that can decide matches against almost any opponent.

MOUZ are another serious contender. They actually lead the 2 November Valve Regional Standings with 1,960 points, narrowly ahead of Vitality’s 1,922. The team is especially dangerous in longer series, as it is able to maintain the quality of its performance and has a great team structure.

Team Spirit also deserves attention, especially with donk and sh1ro capable of taking over games through individual performances. Meanwhile, FURIA brings an aggressive approach and considerable firepower. It is also important to note that because of the format of this tournament, the favorites start their competition at Stage 3, which allows them to prepare and strategize while Stage 1 sorts out the rest of the field.

The Major’s global audience also shows how closely gaming and digital finance now overlap, with more fans buying games, skins and subscriptions with cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum. title: AnyPS5 Passes 61,000 GitHub Stars as GTA 6 Fans Look for a Way Onto PC
content:
AnyPS5, an open-source project that converts PlayStation 5 games into native Windows and Linux programs, has become one of the most-watched repositories on GitHub in the week GTA 6 arrived on consoles. GitHub itself drew attention to it on 26 November, saying the project had passed 58,000 stars since its August launch. By the afternoon of the same day, the repository showed about 61,700 stars, roughly 6,000 forks and more than 1,100 contributors.

The surge is easy to explain, because GTA 6 is only available on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version, so many PC players are watching any project that promises to move console games onto their machines. The project’s own records show it is nowhere near running GTA 6, however, and even GTA 5 is still rough.

GTA 6 is finally here, sparking one of the biggest weeks in gaming and open source on GitHub. The repo AnyPS5 has passed 58K stars since its August launch, rewriting PS5 executables to run on Windows and Linux. Does changing where games run cross a legal line? Share your take.… pic.twitter.com/WY7i9pg1G0

AnyPS5 describes itself as a relinker rather than an emulator. It takes a PS5 game’s executable and converts it into the target system’s native format, then links it against its own reimplementations of the PS5’s system libraries. There is no separate runtime process imitating the console, which is the approach used by traditional emulators.

The project says it does not include or distribute any copyrighted software, firmware, keys or Sony libraries. Its documentation also says the tool does not extract or decrypt game files, and that it needs an executable that has already been decrypted. PS5 games are encrypted on the console, and a claimed game dump on firmware 14.22 this month showed how much effort goes into getting files off it.

The scale of the effort is unusual for a project of this kind. The repository passed 51,000 commits on 26 November and had about 2,400 open pull requests at the same time. It has a set of rules written specifically for AI coding agents, and every pull request has to state whether AI tools were used to make it.

title: 9z CEO Says CS2 Pros Are Discussing a Boycott of the Next Major
content:
Professional Counter-Strike players are discussing a possible boycott of the next Major, according to Francisco “Frankkaster” Postiglione, the chief executive of Argentine organisation 9z. He made the claim on X on 26 November, during the PGL Major Singapore, after saying that the money teams earn from Majors no longer covers the cost of the staff they send. No player, team or players’ group has confirmed any plan publicly, so at this stage it is talk reported by one team owner rather than an organised action.

Frankkaster’s first post went up at 01:54 UTC, hours before 9z played their final match of the event. Writing in Spanish, he said the Major situation was bordering on disastrous, because teams could not even cover the travel costs of the staff who support players and create content. His comments add a team owner’s voice to a complaint that has been building across the scene for most of the season.

Lo del major ya rosa lo nefasto, no llegas ni a cubrir al personal que viaja para asistir jugadores y crear contenido

The boycott claim came in a reply rather than in his original post. At 02:27 UTC, an X user named Alfonsina asked whether it was true that players wanted to organise and stay away from the next Major, adding a one-word call for them to unionise. Frankkaster answered at 04:39 UTC, and his reply is the only direct evidence so far that such a discussion exists.

In that reply, he wrote that “it’s happening”, and said the Argentina Major would be the event to suffer, which angered him most of all. He did not say which players or teams were involved, how many of them backed the idea, or whether anything had been put to Valve or the organisers. Skin-trading accounts on X then spread the exchange in English, describing it as a report that pros were discussing a boycott.

Esta ocurriendo y la va a ligar el major de argentina, eso es lo que mas bronca da

title: Shifters Complete 2027 LEC Roster With Five New Starters
content:
Shifters have finished their 2027 LEC lineup with a full overhaul of the team that struggled in 2026. Adam returns in the top lane, Daglas joins in the jungle, Kamiloo takes the mid lane, SamD plays ADC and Fleshy is the support. Edward Abgaryan takes over as head coach.

Shifters have finished their 2027 LEC lineup with a full overhaul of the team that struggled in 2026. Adam returns in the top lane, Daglas joins in the jungle, Kamiloo takes the mid lane, SamD plays ADC and Fleshy is the support. Edward Abgaryan takes over as head coach.

Shifters were the last team in the league to lock in their lineup. The Swiss organization, formerly known as Team BDS, had a poor 2026 and faced real questions about its future in the LEC. It explored leasing its league slot to another organization. Several teams showed interest, but no deal came together.

That left Shifters with a late start to the offseason and a short window to rebuild. They kept none of the players from the 2026 lineup.

Adam spent almost five seasons in the LEC before leaving the league last year, after too few good offers came in. He went back to the ERLs and now rejoins the team he played for during most of his career. Some fans doubt he can still compete at the top level.

Kamiloo had his first LEC season in 2025, then returned to the ERLs with Karmine Corp. He became one of the best midlaners in the French league there, and that form earned him this chance. He replaces nuc in the mid lane. Karmine Corp are also busy with their own LEC 2027 signing of SkewMond .

title: Gentle Mates : Vatira raconte les coulisses de la création de la superteam avec zen et Atow
content:
Présenté officiellement aux supporters de Gentle Mates mercredi soir lors de la traditionnelle Keynote du club, Axel « Vatira » Touret s’est longuement confié à Sheep Esports sur son choix de rejoindre M8. Après quatre années riches en émotions sous les couleurs de la Karmine Corp, le quadruple vainqueur de Major ressentait le besoin de tourner la page. La réputation de Gentle Mates, sa communauté et les infrastructures du club, notamment sa Gaming House, ont pesé dans la balance.

« Pour moi, c’était la fin d’un cycle. […] Ça a été très difficile parce que j’ai passé pratiquement toute ma carrière là-bas. J’y ai remporté tous mes grands titres et participé à tellement d’événements avec les supporters. J’aime cette organisation, donc oui, ça a été difficile » , a confié Vatira, qui retient notamment son sacre au Major de Paris en mai dernier comme son plus beau souvenir à la Karmine Corp.

Le roster THANOS est là ! pic.twitter.com/HZHuWfvAex

Si les trois grandes structures françaises se sont disputé les signatures de Vatira, zen et Atow durant l’intersaison, les trois joueurs étaient déterminés à évoluer ensemble, quitte à se passer d’une organisation. « Il n’y avait pas vraiment de plan B. Si nous n’avions pas pu monter cette équipe au sein d’une structure, nous l’aurions simplement fait sans structure. Nous voulions absolument jouer ensemble parce que nous savons que nous pouvons être la meilleure équipe. […] Nous aurions formé ce roster quoi qu’il arrive » , a révélé le Français.

Déjà proches en dehors du jeu, les trois joueurs n’ont visiblement pas rencontré de grandes difficultés à trouver leurs automatismes. Vatira avait notamment eu l’occasion d’évoluer avec zen lors de la FIFAe World Cup, tandis qu’Atow et l’ancien prodige de Vitality ont remporté ensemble les premiers championnats du monde de 2v2 en septembre dernier. Une complicité qui s’est rapidement traduite par un premier trophée lors de la Coupe de France, remportée par Gentle Mates en novembre.

Malgré son immense palmarès, Vatira court toujours après un premier titre de champion du monde. Et c’est précisément pour décrocher cette couronne que les trois monstres de la scène francophone ont décidé d’unir leurs forces. « Évidemment, nous voulons aussi remporter d’autres tournois, mais nous sommes tous ici pour gagner les championnats du monde. C’est ce dont les gens se souviendront » , a affirmé le nouveau joueur de Gentle Mates, désireux de marquer l’histoire du club.

title: Liquid outlast Imperial in overtime to clinch Stage 2
content:
Imperial lost their own Cache pick for the second day running, this time in the Major’s first overtime.

Team Liquid are in Stage 2 of the PGL Major Singapore 2026 after a 2-0 win over Imperial Esports (Anubis 13-7, Cache 16-13) that needed the first overtime of the tournament to finish. They go through at 3-1, a day after NIP held them to 11 rounds over two maps. Imperial drop to 2-2.

SHADES OF 2019 📈 pic.twitter.com/zW98m12QSj

Neither team got to play the map it trusted most. Liquid removed Nuke, where Imperial had won 85% of their maps over the last three months and beaten 100 Thieves 13-11 on Tuesday, and Imperial took out Inferno in return. Liquid picked Anubis, a map JT and EliGE were early adopters of in their Complexity days. Imperial went back to Cache, the pick they had lost 13-9 to FlyQuest on Wednesday after leading 6-2, and Mirage was left as the decider.

Liquid were 5-1 up on Anubis before Imperial found any rhythm. The turn came from a round Imperial should not have won: they walked into a plant with four seconds left, decenty covered the bomb and all three of them survived the 3v3. A run of T-side rounds followed, and decenty’s triple on B in the 11th put them 6-5 ahead.

malbsMd took it straight back. With Imperial slipping off the box in the last round of the half, he peeked wide for three kills and 6-6.

title: PGL Major Singapour : le fiasco de FaZe Clan et s1mple…
content:
Le dernier Major de l’année 2026 tourne au cauchemar pour FaZe Clan. Engagée dès le premier tour de la compétition, la formation internationale n’aura remporté qu’une seule rencontre en trois jours. Battus d’entrée par Wildcard (9-13), dupreeh et ses coéquipiers avaient pourtant parfaitement réagi en écrasant GOSH (13-3), avant de rechuter face à PARIVISION (10-13). Dos au mur ce jeudi matin, FaZe n’est pas parvenu à sauver sa peau face à HEROIC.

Malgré une belle réaction sur Ancient, la formation internationale s’est inclinée en trois cartes (1-2), plombée notamment par ses difficultés en attaque sur Mirage et Nuke. Même frozen, meilleur joueur de son équipe sur l’ensemble de la série, n’a pas réussi à inverser la tendance sur la carte décisive. Éliminé avec un bilan d’une victoire pour trois défaites, FaZe termine à la 28-30e place du Major de Singapour. Une bien triste conclusion à une saison particulièrement décevante pour l’organisation.

Out of the Major pic.twitter.com/2Ya2ydpZqW

La désillusion est encore plus grande pour GOSH, nom sous lequel évolue BC.Game Esports à Singapour pour se conformer à la législation locale sur les jeux d’argent. Malgré la présence de deux anciens champions de Major, Oleksandr « s1mple » Kostyliev et Emil « Magisk » Reif, la formation internationale a complètement manqué son rendez-vous. Balayée par Team Liquid (1-13) puis FaZe Clan (3-13) lors de la première journée, elle jouait déjà sa survie mercredi face aux Mongols de Chinggis Warriors.

Alors qu’ils menaient 11-6 sur Ancient, s1mple et ses coéquipiers ont encaissé sept rounds consécutifs pour finalement s’incliner (11-13). Malgré une prestation exceptionnelle de Senzu sur Dust2 (13-6), avec 2.51 de rating, GOSH a définitivement rendu les armes sur Nuke (10-13). Un terrible fiasco pour ce projet ambitieux, qui quitte Singapour sur un bilan de trois défaites et une seule carte remportée. Avant même l’entrée en lice des grands favoris de la compétition, plusieurs des plus grandes légendes de Counter-Strike sont donc déjà sur le chemin du retour.

SHOCKING: s1mple's team GOSH are ELIMINATED from the Singapore Major > They finish 0-3 (!!) > Only won 1 map in their entire run > s1mple's return to a CS Major was a disaster And they ruin everyone's Pickems in the process pic.twitter.com/ZwJJ8RrJrc

title: Gentle Mates Sign Boaster and Alfajer for VCT 2027, Confirm Rainbow Six Siege Entry
content:
Gentle Mates have signed Jake “Boaster” Howlett to lead their VALORANT roster for VCT EMEA 2027 and confirmed their entry into Rainbow Six Siege esports. The French organisation revealed both moves during its 2027 Keynote stream on 25 November 2026. Boaster joins with his Fnatic teammate Emir “Alfajer” Ali Beder, ending a Fnatic run of nearly six years.

The Keynote also confirmed that Gentle Mates will host Call of Duty League (CDL) Major 1 2027 at the Plenitude Arena in Paris from 12 to 14 February.

Gentle Mates posted the full five player lineup on X after the stream. Former Sentinels head coach Adam “kaplan” Kaplan leads the team from the bench.

Kozzy is a 16 year old Romanian duelist, which makes him the youngest player on the roster. The lineup mixes two of EMEA’s most experienced players with younger talent, and Boaster takes over as in game leader.

Gentle Mates hold a VCT partner slot for the 2027 and 2028 seasons, and 2027 is their first year in the programme. About a month ago, the club released all five players from its 2026 roster, marteen, starxo, Minny, Proxh and H1ber, along with head coach Jiri “KUNDIKUNDI” Honkala and assistant coach Erim “Mavera” Sasal.

As a partner team, Gentle Mates get an automatic place in VCT EMEA 2027 Kickoff. The rebuild is one of the biggest moves of an offseason that has also seen TenZ sign with T1 for VCT Pacific 2027 and Vitality promote Scutt to head coach . Fnatic now has to replace both its captain and Alfajer, after a 2026 season in which several big names were among the teams that missed VALORANT Champions 2026 .

title: LCK : après Canyon, Hanwha Life officialise Kiin
content:
Quelques jours après avoir annoncé le recrutement de Canyon, Hanwha Life Esports a officialisé ce jeudi la signature de Kim « Kiin » Ki-in. Libre depuis la fin de son contrat avec Gen.G le 16 novembre dernier, le toplaner de 27 ans succède à Zeus, parti retrouver ses anciens coéquipiers chez T1. Il reformera surtout son duo avec Canyon, avec qui il évoluait depuis 2024.

Doublement titré sur la scène nationale en 2026, avec des sacres en LCK Cup et lors des playoffs de fin de saison, Kiin reste également sur une finale des Worlds perdue face à Bilibili Gaming. Une recrue de premier choix pour Hanwha Life Esports, qui espère retrouver les sommets après une élimination prématurée lors du Swiss Stage des derniers championnats du monde.

Malgré son sacre au MSI 2026, HLE a profondément remanié son effectif durant l’intersaison. Outre les départs de Zeus, Kanavi et Delight, la structure a également renouvelé son staff technique en confiant les rênes de l’équipe à Mowgli. Avec les arrivées de Kiin et Canyon, associés à Zeka et Gumayusi, le club dispose déjà d’une impressionnante force de frappe.

Il ne reste désormais plus qu’un poste à pourvoir pour compléter ce cinq majeur. Tout juste libéré par Dplus KIA, qui lui a préféré Delight, le jeune Oh « Career » Hyung-seok est pressenti pour accompagner Gumayusi sur la botlane. Avec un tel recrutement, Hanwha Life Esports devrait une nouvelle fois figurer parmi les grands favoris de la LCK en 2027.

title: 100 Thieves send 9z home 2-1 after rain’s Dust2 revival
content:
Nuke was rain’s worst map of the Major. Dust2 was his best.

On Nuke, rain finished with 29.4 ADR, five kills and a team that had just lost 13-5 with elimination one map away. On Dust2, he went 26-8. 100 Thieves came back to beat 9z 2-1 (Nuke 5-13, Dust2 13-6, Ancient 13-5), their first Bo3 win at a Major, and stay alive at the PGL Major Singapore 2026 in the do-or-die 2-2 pool. 9z leave Singapore with a 1-3 record.

100 Thieves’ Counter-Strike team confirmed it a few minutes after the last round.

WE LIVE TO FIGHT ANOTHER DAY #100TR GG @9zTeam pic.twitter.com/rAlFCpGiT4

Nuke was 9z’s choice, and on paper a strange one: they had won 27% of their Nuke maps over the last three months. It did not show. They rushed top side in the pistol round, converted the next one, and HUASOPEEK cleared A with four kills in the fourth. 100 Thieves did not win a round until the fifth, and from there 9z kept catching their CT players rotating the wrong way. HUASOPEEK went 13-6 on the T side, and 9z led 8-4 at the half.

They won the second pistol as well, and when 100 Thieves forced and planted to make it 9-5, luchov answered with three kills on a Five-SeveN.

title: How To Fix The GTA VI Weather Bug and Bring Back Rain
content:
The GTA 6 weather bug keeps Leonida stuck on clear skies for long stretches, and players on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S still report it. Rockstar released update 01.002.002 on November 23 to fix weather that does not change for extended periods. Many players say the problem remains. A manual workaround is now spreading.

This guide covers the steps for both consoles, what the patch changed, and what to expect after you try the fix.

GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Soon after, players said rain and storms rarely appeared. Weather did change for some of them, but far less often than intended, and some conditions lasted too long.

Rockstar responded with update 01.002.002 . Its patch notes say the update fixed an issue that stopped weather from changing for extended periods. Some players still see the same problem after installing it.

Clearing the system cache is the workaround players now use. Rockstar also provides its own support steps for clearing the Xbox cache.

Cache clearing does not remove your saves or inventory. On Xbox, Rockstar says the steps reset brightness and language settings.

title: FaZe Knocked Out of PGL Major Singapore With a 1-3 Record
content:
FaZe are out of PGL Major Singapore after losing 1-2 to HEROIC in Stage One, finishing 1-3 in 28th to 30th place. It is the organization's weakest Major result since they went winless at IEM Rio 2022.

FaZe's run at PGL Major Singapore ended in Stage One. HEROIC beat them 2-1 in the elimination match, which left the organization on a 1-3 record and in 28th to 30th place. It is FaZe's weakest Major showing since they went winless at IEM Rio 2022.

HEROIC controlled the opening map. They won Mirage 13-3 and gave FaZe very little to work with.

Ancient gave FaZe a brief reason for hope. FaZe led 7-5 after their CT half and survived a tight second half to take it 13-11. That forced a deciding map.

Nuke went the other way. HEROIC opened 9-3 on their CT side and closed it out 13-4, which sent FaZe home.

FaZe's only victory in Singapore came against GOSH, who play under the BC.Game name. GOSH had their own struggles and went home winless after three losses the day before. FaZe had opened their event with a loss to Wildcard.

title: PVISION win their worst map to sweep Lynn Vision into Stage 2
content:
Dust2 had been PVISION’s weakest map for three months.

In the last three months, PARIVISION had won two of their 10 maps on Dust2. The 11th went their way 13-10, against the team that picked it, as PVISION swept Lynn Vision 2-0 (Ancient 13-7, Dust2 13-10) to reach Stage 2 of the PGL Major Singapore 2026 with a 3-1 record. Lynn Vision, who had won 79% of their 14 Dust2 maps in the same period, go into Friday’s 2-2 matches instead.

PGL confirmed the result minutes after the last round.

PVISION are through to Stage 2 of the PGL Major Singapore 2026 🇸🇬 A 2-0 over @Lynnvision_ in the qualification match seals a 3-1 finish. Lynn Vision drop to 2-2 and will have to fight again for their spot. #PGLMajor pic.twitter.com/fasMI1TN8F

PVISION’s own map pick started like a formality. Lynn Vision won the pistol round, PVISION took the force-buy straight back through a HObbit double with a Tec-9 and led 5-1. Then their slow, default-heavy T side ran into its usual danger. In the seventh round they ran down the clock, never got the bomb down in time and lost the round, and Jame lost his AWP with it.

That opened the door for Lynn Vision’s best spell of the morning. With PVISION on armour and Tec-9s in back-to-back rounds, Westmelon lined up a triple kill on B, EmiliaQAQ followed with two clean kills of his own, and Lynn Vision won five of the last six rounds of the half to level it at 6-6. Westmelon finished their CT half 12-9 with 132.4 ADR.

title: LCS : Zven lâche FlyQuest pour OpTic Gaming
content:
Le mercato nord-américain vient de connaître un rebondissement pour le moins inattendu. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Jesper « Zven » Svenningsen aurait décidé de revenir sur son accord verbal avec FlyQuest pour s’engager auprès d’OpTic Gaming. L’AD Carry danois de 29 ans avait pourtant donné son feu vert à FlyQuest à la mi-novembre, poussant la structure à mettre un terme à ses recherches pour ce poste. Mais l’arrivée tardive d’OpTic Gaming sur le marché des transferts aurait finalement changé la donne, le vétéran ayant accepté une nouvelle offre dans la soirée de mardi.

Ce revirement place FlyQuest dans une situation particulièrement délicate, alors que la majorité des AD Carry évoluant en LCS ont déjà trouvé leur point de chute pour 2027. Son ancien titulaire, Massu, devrait notamment poursuivre sa carrière chez Shopify Rebellion. La structure nord-américaine, qui comptait aligner Zamudo, Yukino, Hwichan, Zven et Cryogen, doit donc reprendre ses recherches à un stade déjà bien avancé du mercato. Une rupture d’accord verbal à l’initiative d’un joueur reste extrêmement rare au plus haut niveau de la scène compétitive.

Après six années passées chez Cloud9 en deux passages distincts, Zven devrait donc ouvrir un nouveau chapitre de sa carrière. Finaliste du Winter Split et demi-finaliste du Spring Split des LCS en 2026, le Danois avait été écarté du cinq titulaire à l’approche du Summer Split, au même titre qu’APA, à la suite des résultats décevants de Cloud9. Après plusieurs mois éloigné de la compétition, l’ancien joueur de G2 Esports s’apprête ainsi à retrouver une place de titulaire dans le championnat nord-américain.

De retour en LCS à la place de Dignitas, OpTic Gaming semble vouloir miser sur un mélange de jeunesse et d’expérience pour son nouveau projet. La structure aurait déjà trouvé des accords avec le jungler KryRa et le midlaner Toasty, deux jeunes talents désireux de s’imposer dans l’élite nord-américaine. Avec Zven, OpTic s’offrirait un joueur particulièrement expérimenté, capable d’encadrer ses jeunes recrues et d’endosser un rôle de leader au sein de cette nouvelle formation.
